create_ImageFolderDataset_from_directory: create an ImageFolderDataset from a directory of images for StyleGAN2 training
create_ImageFolderDataset_from_zip: create an ImageFolderDataset from a zip file containing images and optional labels
create_ImageFolderDataset_from_hdf5: create an ImageFolderDataset from an HDF5 file with preloaded image data
load_image_with_Dataset_getitem: load an image and its label from a Dataset by index using getitem
get_label_onehot_from_Dataset: get a one-hot encoded label for a given index from the Dataset
